chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Count it back-wards, count it down, / ten to one, now turn a-round! / Ten, nine, eight, sev-en, six, / five, four, three, two, one, blast off!

rocket.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
rocket.lyrics: Our lit-tle rock-et's on the ground, / en-gines rum-ble, what a sound! / Hel-mets on and buck-le in, / now the count-down will be-gin!

cd10.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
cd10.lyrics: Ten! Nine! Eight! Sev-en! / Six! Five! Four! / Three! Two! One! / Blast off! Zoom up to the stars!

space.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
space.lyrics: Up, up, past the moon so bright, / wave hel-lo to the stars at night! / Time to fly back home a-gain, / let's count down from twen-ty, friends!

cd20.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
cd20.lyrics: Twen-ty, nine-teen, eight-een, sev-en-teen, / six-teen, fif-teen, four-teen, thir-teen, / twelve, e-lev-en, ten, nine, eight, / sev-en, six, five, four, three, two, one! Touch-down!

bubbles.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
bubbles.lyrics: Five big bub-bles float-ing high, / pop! Now four go drift-ing by. / Four, then three, then two, then one, / pop, pop, pop! The bub-bles are done!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

actions.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
actions.lyrics: Crouch down low, ten, nine, eight, / sev-en, six, five, wait, wait, wait! / Four, three, two, one, jump up high, / blast off, rock-et, to the sky!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's count down slow-ly! / Five / Four / Three, two / One, blast off!
